## cheerful-unicorn

### Description and Rationale
I am an independent participant registering under CO2gap, with an interest in aviation data, operational efficiency and CO2 emissions.

I am joining the challenge to explore a practical taxi-out time prediction problem using open data and reproducible methods. I will use AI-assisted development tools to support the work, while retaining responsibility for the modelling choices, validation and documentation.

My aim is to develop and openly share a clear, original and reproducible solution.
